usedFor: SprintOps holds the tasks, and Conversion Chats receives work through “Send Template Message” after “When a task is assigned”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a task is assigned” in SprintOps, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: An assignment is the moment someone needs to know, so the template message can follow it.

watchOut: “When a task is updated” fires on every edit, so keep “Send Template Message” on “When a task is assigned”.
